Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL3572 (Cholesteryl ester transfer protein). Join activities to assays and target_dictionary, and join activities to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures. Filter by target ChEMBL ID, standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, and non-null pChEMBL value. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Return the first 1000 rows.
